|game_text=''When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile.'' Lose X cards stacked on [[I Know That Laugh]] to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Under_Jabbas_Protection.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: '''this page''' (original, release sheet of 14 September 2012); [[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 12 December 2012); [[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); [[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012), page 4, slip 26 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Under_Jabbas_Protection.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-underjabbasprotection-pre.gif]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 36) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 3)]], the same words).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36, page 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) changed “into hand” to “in hand”, added a colon (“Use 1 Force to: take”) and printed “objective” and “lost pile” in lower case<ref name="cl-1282_26-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013 (the card is not in the capture of 21 July 2012, before Virtual Block 8.2)</ref>: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to: take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh in hand (or stack top card of lost pile on it).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-04-Under_Jabbas_Protection-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 36)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 3)]]) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1282-26-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Under Jabba's Protection (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-underjabbasprotection-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text (this page) again, word for word: “When you play this Interrupt, may place a Rep on your Objective in Used Pile. Lose X cards stacked on I Know That Laugh to reduce a weapon or battle destiny total by X. OR Use 1 Force to take a card stacked on I Know That Laugh into hand (or stack top card of Lost Pile on it).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:53<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034752/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
